name: Zstandard
summary: Official-source Zstandard 1.5.7 WebAssembly with real browser-core and upstream browser-full CLI, plus reviewed release packaging and a published-release-only Playground.

zoo.provenance: in-toto/SLSA Provenance v1 (reviewed, generated by CI; awaiting manual GitHub release)
zoo.sbom: CycloneDX 1.6 JSON (reviewed, generated by CI; awaiting manual GitHub release)

profiles.label: Browser Core (canary)
features: exact upstream libzstd 1.5.7 compression and decompression
profiles.output: Experimental Zstandard compression/decompression library, not yet a generic CLI or published package
profiles.size: Measured from generated release manifest (publication pending)

profiles.label: Browser Full (upstream CLI; experimental)
features: original upstream zstd command-line source, not a JavaScript reimplementation
normal .zst compression and decompression using staged MEMFS paths
fresh isolated Worker for each CLI invocation
native zstd interoperability tested in both directions on CI
dictionary CLI is compiled but its browser behavior remains an unverified capability
profiles.output: Experimental normal zstd CLI arguments, run with browser MEMFS
profiles.size: Measured from generated release manifest (publication pending)

comparison.name: Upstream native
comparison.note: Reference libzstd C library and full CLI, native filesystem and optional multithreading.

comparison.name: WASM Zoo
comparison.note: Experimental browser-core plus original upstream zstd CLI browser-full. CLI uses MEMFS rather than a native OS filesystem, and omits pthreads, legacy frames and external format codecs.

notes: Phase 3 release recipe: verified browser-core and browser-full binaries, matching exact upstream source/build recipes, standalone provenance/SBOM and SHA256SUMS. These are CI artifacts until a human pushes the reviewed release tag.
Playground loads only GitHub Release ZIPs verified at Pages deploy. It intentionally displays release-pending until zstd-v0.3.0 is published by the manual-tag workflow.
No Zstandard GitHub release or npm publication is asserted by merging the release preparation PR; a separate metadata promotion PR can mark it available after assets actually publish.
Upstream Zstandard 1.5.7 exact reviewed commit f8745da6ff1ad1e7bab384bd1f9d742439278e99 and Emscripten 6.0.7 exact reviewed commit stay pinned.
Both browser-core and upstream browser-full CLI are real-browser tested; upstream browser-full also requires bidirectional native .zst frame interoperability in release CI.
CLI omits native pthreads, native filesystem, external gzip/xz/lz4 codecs and legacy frame decoding; dictionary behavior and streaming JS API are not release-validated.
Zstandard candidate mode remains none; libvips remains adapter-gated. No workflow automatically merges or creates release tags.

referenceWasm.name: zstd-codec
referenceWasm.note: The third-party source repository's cpp/zstd submodule points to commit 4fa456d7f12f8b27bd3b2f5dfd4f46898cb31c24 (v1.3.6). This is source-pin evidence, not a binary audit of npm.

capabilityMatrix.note: Both profiles use the official 1.5.7 C sources. Browser-full also requires real CLI compress/decompress and bidirectional native frame compatibility in CI.
The native upstream CLI has file-I/O streaming, including staged MEMFS files. The JS adapter still buffers inputs/outputs and this phase does not assert a streaming JS API or unknown-size test.
The full upstream CLI and libzstd dictionary code are linked, but browser dictionary behavior is not yet tested as a release gate.

capabilityMatrix.feature: Original upstream zstd CLI using MEMFS
capabilityMatrix.note: Builds original upstream programs/*.c including zstdcli.c; arguments and file paths apply to staged Emscripten MEMFS rather than a native host filesystem.
Both profiles are single-threaded in fresh outer Workers. No COOP/COEP required.
No Zoo network access. Each runtime fetches self-hosted local JavaScript/WASM assets.

capabilityMatrix.feature: Native host filesystem and shell pipelines
capabilityMatrix.note: Neither browser profile can access OS files directly; CLI inputs/outputs are staged in MEMFS, and stdout/stderr are captured.

capabilityMatrix.feature: External gzip/xz/lz4 codec formats and legacy-frame decoding
capabilityMatrix.note: The browser-full CLI is compiled without optional native codec libraries, pthreads or legacy-frame code.

integration.summary: Experimental upstream Zstandard CLI accepts standard zstd command-line arguments with files staged into an isolated Worker MEMFS.
notes: Experimental: link to a local build, not a released or published npm package.
Inputs and outputs must use safe absolute MEMFS paths. Maximum total staged input and collected output is 64 MiB.
